Method.name: GetComponentId
Method.Implementation: Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetComponentId") &sql(Select ID INTO :compId from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.Component where ComponentName = :compNm) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Could not get Component Id for " _ compNm _ " from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.Component") Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT } Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("ComponentId: " _ compId) return compId

Method.name: GetEnvironmentId
Method.Implementation: Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetEnvironmentId") &sql(Select ID INTO :envId from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.Environment where Name = :env) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Could not get Env Id for " _ env _ " from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.Environment") Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT } Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("EnvironmentId: " _ envId) return envId

Method.name: GetClassesForComponent
Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassesForComponent") set clsList = ##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New() NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON"
set compId = ..GetComponentId(compNm)
&sql(Declare C1 Cursor for select distinct(classname) into :clsNm from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.ClassItem where componentName = :compId)
Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C1) While (SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH C1) if SQLCODE = 0 { Do clsList.Insert(clsNm) } }
&sql(CLOSE C1) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("ClassesForComponent: " _ clsList.Count()) Quit clsList

Method.name: GetClassInformation
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON" Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassInformation")
set clsList = ##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New()
set envId = ..GetEnvironmentId(env)
&sql(Declare C2 Cursor for select ClassName, ClassExportFile, ClassExportFileVersion INTO :clsNm, :clsfile, :version from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.ClassItem where ClassName = :clsName and Environment = :envId and ClassExportFileVersion = :revNum) Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C2) While (SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH C2)
if (SQLCODE = 0) { Do clsList.Insert(clsNm _ "," _ clsfile _ "," _ version) } } &sql(CLOSE C2) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassInformation: " _ clsList.Count()) Quit clsList

Method.name: UpdateComponentImpl
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON" Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("UpdateComponentImpl") set compId = ..GetComponentId(componentNm)
set envId = ..GetEnvironmentId(env)
set dt = $ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,3, 1)
&sql(INSERT INTO ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.ComponentImpl (ComponentName, Environment, ImplFile, ImplFileVersion, ImplFileInformation, ImplementionDate ) values (:compId, :envId, :DeploymentFile, :fileVersion, :fileInfo, :dt ) ) if SQLCODE = 0 { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Insert done") return $$$OK } else { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Insert to ComponentImpl failed " _ $SYSTEM.SQL.SQLCODE(SQLCODE)) Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT }
